terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: One piece of the PEDESTRIAN OVERPASS set, built to the modular contract in the registry notes: a span module runs 8 m along Z with its pivot at the centre of the deck UNDERSIDE and is placed at y = 5.5 to put its walking surface at 6.0; a stair flight rises 3.0 m over 4 m from its foot at the pivot; columns and landings carry their seats at 5.5 or 6.0 to match. Nothing opens, turns or swings; nothing attaches. One root pivot and zero sockets is the whole contract, and every end face is flat and square so chained pieces never z-fight. The BMA overpass stair: 17 risers at 0.176 climbing 3.0 m over 4.0 m, chequer-plate or concrete treads between stringers or walls, pipe rails 1.1 over the nosings.

reasoning: 2 component(s) on 2 material(s), 2 draw calls of 4.

No repetition system: nothing on this piece repeats often enough to earn one.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 2.20 x 4.10 x 4.00 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; none collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.
actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

evidence: Measured on region-wall: the plate reads #7e776d (luma 120). Authored #8f8e8a over the #d8d7d2 concrete envelope for the vertical-face transfer, with the walked and up faces held down by faceTint.up. Renders #73736d (114) on the walls, #8c9287 (144) on the treads after faceTint.up 0.5.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: 2 component(s) + 0 repetition system(s) = 2 of 4. Parts that share a material ride one merged geometry and one submission.

materials.note: 2 of 3: every tone inside a material is a vertex colour or a canvas ratio over its envelope, never a second material.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1100 of 4000, measured off the built module by render-model.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Tinted boxes, extruded (x, y) profiles and profile SWEEPS along a straight, sheared or arced path merged per material; cylinders where the plate shows a round section.
No InstancedMesh: nothing on this piece repeats enough to earn one. In a level the HOST instances the whole module.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. Surface identity is one post-construction canvas tile per material -- cast concrete with a form-tie grid, lift lines and pinholes; asphalt with its lane marks; painted steel with rust -- bound as map and bump after construction, so createObjectModel does no per-pixel work but the tiles.

risks.description: Seen end-on the flight is a void between two parapet walls, the treads spanning them with nothing behind. The turntable gate reads the backdrop through it as an interior hole (20.5-20.9% of the foreground at azimuth 90/270).
risks.mitigation: allow_holes is set on that measurement, with the scratch/_holecc.mjs thickness per azimuth in the gate log: the enclosed components are many pixels thick, so they are real openings and not an edge gradient crossing the backdrop value.

risks.description: One three-quarter plate: the far side and the underside are inferred from the module's own symmetry.
risks.mitigation: Recorded as region-far at confidence 0.90; nothing asymmetric is invented on the unseen side.
